term: temporal unity and selected sustaining explanation in #85
definition: The relevant explanandum is what holds contingent beings together through time. Intrinsic explanations and other contingent beings are excluded by separate commitments. A selected sustainer, if any, is assigned necessity, incompositeness and atemporality; no actual existence or common uniqueness is included by this glossary.
note: Diachronic sustaining explanation is not silently identified with a uniting cause of a composite’s esse, actual grounding or Ontic causation. The printed “sustaining case” is retained as an editorial issue; a cause reading does not itself supply causal semantics or adequacy. No independent Braine attribution or modal domain identity.
